obligations.description: Implement module "server-core" per its finalized contract (inputs: HTTP request payloads, Configuration state, Backend response streams → outputs: Proxied HTTP responses, SSE streams, Circuit breaker failure metrics; validation boundary: Validates incoming HTTP requests and SSE event structures against JSON schemas).
Mid-stream network resets or SSE truncations must report failure to circuit breaker (verification_obligation: test stream failures)
Handle failure mode: Backend socket reset or timeout (caller receives error SSE or failover to candidate)

Implement module "backend-auth" per its finalized contract (inputs: Target specification, Environment credentials → outputs: Upstream HTTP response, Resolved auth headers; validation boundary: Validates target existence and authorization credential presence).
Env-var credential resolution must consistently use readCredential across routing and header construction (verification_obligation: unit test authEnv & backend)
Handle failure mode: Missing or invalid credential (caller receives unauthenticated error or failover)

Implement module "config-routing" per its finalized contract (inputs: Raw configuration files, Incoming prompt / system messages → outputs: Parsed configuration object, Relay directives and subagent flags; validation boundary: Validates schema of configuration file and model routing parameters).
Subagent directive parsing must strictly restrict @relay: matching to explicitly authorized user prompt blocks (verification_obligation: prompt injection security tests)
Handle failure mode: Invalid configuration format (throws RoutingError or configuration validation error)

Implement module "cli-tools" per its finalized contract (inputs: Command line arguments, Environment flags → outputs: Parsed CLI commands, Quoted shell arguments; validation boundary: Validates CLI option flags and command names).
SHELL_SAFE regex and positional argument parsing must correctly handle backslashes and flag ordering (verification_obligation: test CLI argument quoting)
Handle failure mode: Unknown command or invalid flag options
